sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: Qwen 2.5 Coder 1.5B: Local Coding Model (1.2GB VRAM)
sources.snippet: Qwen 2.5 Coder 1.5B Lightweight Local Coding Model from Alibaba Cloud Released October 2024 by Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team. Qwen 2.5 Coder 1.5B is a genuinely small code-focused LLM that scores 43.3% on HumanEval with only 1.5 billion parameters.
